svg.title: Exit codes
svg.desc: Exit: 0, Meaning: Done, What to do: ; Exit: 1, Meaning: Umbra itself failed, What to do: Read stderr; the next command starts the daemon again; Exit: 2, Meaning: Deadline, cancellation, or a script error, What to do: Inspect actual state before retrying an action; use a condition or fix the script; Exit: 3, Meaning: Signed out (read --cookie, keep-signed-in), What to do: Run umbra sign-in <site>; Exit: 4, Meaning: Page/download failure, output bound or uncertain workflow step, What to do: Read the message; verify actual state before resolving or repeating a step; Exit: 5, Meaning: HTTP error status (fetch, download, http), What to do: Check the URL and your access; Exit: 64, Meaning: Usage error, What to do: Fix the command; umbra help <command>; Exit: 78, Meaning: sites.json can't be parsed, What to do: Fix the file; the message names the problem
